days.title: Day 1 | Arrival in Tbilisi | Hotel Check-in & Evening at Leisure
activities: Arrive at Tbilisi International Airport; warm welcome by our driver/guide.
Private transfer to your hotel in Tbilisi and smooth check-in.
Evening at leisure to stroll through illuminated Rustaveli Avenue or relax at cozy Georgian cafes.
Overnight stay in Tbilisi.

days.title: Day 2 | Tbilisi City Tour: Old Town, Narikala & Sulphur Baths
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Comprehensive Tbilisi city tour: stroll cobblestone streets of Old Tbilisi (Dzveli Tbilisi).
Take the aerial ropeway cable car up to the 4th-century Narikala Fortress for commanding views.
Visit the monumental Kartlis Deda (Mother of Georgia) statue.
Explore the historic Abanotubani Sulphur Bath district and the hidden Leghvtakhevi waterfall canyon.
Cross the iconic modern Bridge of Peace over the Mtkvari River and relax in Rike Park.
Evening at leisure; overnight stay in Tbilisi.

days.title: Day 3 | Scenic Military Highway: Ananuri, Gudauri & Kazbegi
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Embark on an exhilarating drive north along the historic Georgian Military Highway into the Greater Caucasus.
Stop at the turquoise Zhinvali Reservoir and explore the medieval Ananuri Fortress complex.
Drive past the ski resort of Gudauri and stop at the Russian-Georgian Friendship Monument viewpoint.
Arrive in Stepantsminda (Kazbegi) under the shadow of Mount Kazbek (5,054m); hotel check-in.
Overnight stay in Kazbegi.

days.title: Day 4 | Gergeti Trinity Church & Return to Tbilisi
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Take a 4x4 mountain ride up to the iconic 14th-century Gergeti Trinity Church perched dramatically at 2,170m.
Take in breathtaking panoramic views of snow-capped Mount Kazbek and the surrounding mountain valleys.
Scenic drive back south through the Dariali gorge towards Tbilisi.
Evening free for dinner at a traditional Georgian tavern with live polyphonic music and Khinkali / Khachapuri.
Overnight stay in Tbilisi.

days.title: Day 5 | Mtskheta UNESCO Heritage Sites & Shopping
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Drive to the ancient capital of Georgia, Mtskheta (a UNESCO World Heritage Site).
Visit the 6th-century Jvari Monastery overlooking the picturesque confluence of the Aragvi and Mtkvari rivers.
Explore the grand Svetitskhoveli Cathedral, burial site of Christ's mantle and spiritual heart of Georgia.
Browse Mtskheta's charming souvenir market for Georgian spices, Churchkhela sweets, and ceramics.
Return to Tbilisi for last-minute shopping at the Dry Bridge Flea Market or Galleria Mall.
Overnight stay in Tbilisi.

days.title: Day 6 | Tbilisi Departure
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Free time depending on your flight schedule.
Private transfer to Tbilisi International Airport for your onward journey.

days.title: Day 1 | Arrival in Tbilisi | Hotel Check-in & Evening at Leisure
activities: Arrive at Tbilisi International Airport; meet and greet with our representative.
Private transfer to your 4★ hotel in Tbilisi and smooth check-in.
Evening at leisure to wander the charming old streets or relax.
Overnight stay in Tbilisi.

days.title: Day 2 | Tbilisi City Tour: Old Tbilisi, Cable Car & Sulphur Baths
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Explore historic Old Tbilisi: Meidan Square, Sioni Cathedral, and Anchiskhati Basilica.
Ride the cable car to Narikala Fortress and Mother of Georgia statue for magnificent skyline views.
Walk down through the historic brick-domed Sulphur Baths of Abanotubani and the canyon waterfall.
Stroll across the futuristic Bridge of Peace into landscaped Rike Park.
Overnight stay in Tbilisi.

days.title: Day 3 | Georgian Military Highway: Ananuri, Gudauri & Kazbegi
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Journey into the high Caucasus along the scenic Georgian Military Highway.
Visit the turquoise Zhinvali Reservoir and the 17th-century Ananuri Fortress complex.
Ascend through Gudauri ski resort; stop at the Friendship Monument panoramic viewpoint.
Arrive in Kazbegi (Stepantsminda) with views of Mount Kazbek; check in to hotel.
Overnight stay in Kazbegi.

days.title: Day 4 | Gergeti Trinity Church & Return to Tbilisi
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Board 4WD vehicles to reach the 14th-century Gergeti Trinity Church situated high on a plateau.
Marvel at the jaw-dropping vistas of Mount Kazbek (5,054m).
Drive back down to Tbilisi in the afternoon.
Evening at leisure for dining at traditional Georgian taverns.
Overnight stay in Tbilisi.

days.title: Day 5 | Kakheti Wine Region: Sighnaghi, Bodbe & Wine Tasting
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Full-day tour to Kakheti, the cradle of 8,000-year-old Georgian winemaking.
Visit the hilltop walled town of Sighnaghi, known as the 'City of Love', with panoramic views of the Alazani Valley.
Visit Bodbe Nunnery, the sacred resting place of St. Nino who brought Christianity to Georgia.
Visit a traditional local winery to taste famous Georgian wines crafted in clay amphorae (Qvevri).
Return to Tbilisi in the evening; overnight stay in Tbilisi.

days.title: Day 6 | Mtskheta UNESCO Heritage Trail & Farewell Dinner
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Visit Mtskheta, Georgia's former royal capital.
Tour Jvari Monastery perched high on a cliff edge above two merging rivers.
Visit Svetitskhoveli Cathedral, the historic burial site of Georgian kings.
Return to Tbilisi; free time for shopping at the Dry Bridge antique market or shopping malls.
Enjoy a festive Georgian farewell dinner with folk music and dance.
Overnight stay in Tbilisi.

days.title: Day 7 | Tbilisi Departure
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Transfer to Tbilisi International Airport for your departure flight home.
